title: Galic
summary: GA'LIC, adjective [from Gael, Gaul, Gallia.] An epithet denoting what belongs to the Gaels, tribes of Celtic origin inhabiting the highlands of Scotland; as the Gaelic language. GA'ELIC, noun The lang

inlines.v: GA'LIC, adjective [from Gael, Gaul, Gallia.] An epithet denoting what belongs to the Gaels, tribes of Celtic origin inhabiting the highlands of Scotland; as the Gaelic language. GA'ELIC, noun The language of the highlanders of Scotland.
